finding_flock.name: FindingFlock / OpenStreetMap volunteer reports
finding_flock.description: FindingFlock is the public map source OWVAZ may use for reviewed city-level ALPR count snapshots.

deflock.name: DeFlock
deflock.description: DeFlock is listed as an additional public, community-oriented ALPR camera map. OWVAZ is not currently using DeFlock for automated city-level count polling.

flock_surveillance_map.name: FLOCK Surveillance Network Map
flock_surveillance_map.description: The FLOCK Surveillance Network Map is listed as broader public research context. OWVAZ is not currently using it for automated city-level count polling.
flock_surveillance_map.site_notice: The FLOCK Surveillance Network Map describes itself as an independent research site presenting Joshua Michael’s cybersecurity work. It says it is not affiliated with or endorsed by Flock Safety, Flock Group, Inc., or their products; that Flock names and marks belong to their respective owners and are used only to identify the research subject; and that use of copyrighted material is intended as fair use for criticism, comment, scholarship, and research under 17 U.S.C. § 107.

litchfield-park.vendor_note: FindingFlock identifies all 29 as Flock Safety units.
litchfield-park.density_note: FindingFlock lists the city at 8.8 readers per square mile.
litchfield-park.count_note: This count is useful public-source context, but it is not an official City inventory.

findingflock.title: FindingFlock / OpenStreetMap volunteer reports
findingflock.manufacturer_summary: FindingFlock identifies 22 of the 23 documented readers as Flock Safety units and 1 as Motorola Solutions.
findingflock.density_summary: FindingFlock lists Avondale at 0.5 readers per square mile.
findingflock.caveat: This count is useful public-source context, but it is not an official City inventory. FindingFlock locations are documented through public volunteer mapping and may lag behind camera additions, removals, or changes in the field.
